schema: CREATE TABLE members (id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, member_name TEXT, region TEXT); CREATE TABLE awards (id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, member_id INTEGER, title TEXT, award_date DATE, FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES members (id));
correct_query: SELECT T1.member_name FROM members AS T1 INNER JOIN awards AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.member_id WHERE T2.title = 'Gold' LIMIT 5

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Adds a redundant DISTINCT when projecting a parent attribute over a 1-to-many join with LIMIT and no ORDER BY.
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT DISTINCT m.member_name FROM members AS m JOIN awards AS a ON m.id = a.member_id WHERE a.title = 'Gold' LIMIT 5
